raw_comment: Looking at the graph, I noticed that the central U.S. states have the worst droughts. These areas might be more affected because of their rough terrain and extreme weather. I wonder if global warming and climate change are making these droughts worse. This is important to me and my community because it shows how climate change is impacting us all. A good headline for this graph could be "Drought in Your State."
